\begin{frame}{Mathematical Formulation}
Introductory remarks with inline regression equation $Y_i = \beta_0 + \beta_1 X_i + \varepsilon_i$.

\begin{block}{Least-Squares Estimator}
The slope parameter estimate is given by:
\[
\hat{\beta}_1 = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^n (X_i - \bar{X})(Y_i - \bar{Y})}{\sum_{i=1}^n (X_i - \bar{X})^2}
\]
\end{block}

Concluding remarks on residual variance $\sigma^2$.
\end{frame}
